description: Acceptance requirements, not network results. blocked cases require protocol changes and new tests before financial acceptance.

cases.reason: Verify RAVE output AND separately signed recipient Accept.
Wrong signature must not consume parked value.
Foreign DNA must not satisfy the witness quorum.
The release proof does not identify an action target or bind statements to it.
Signed time lower bounds may be safely reused; no one-use proof policy exists. Define replay as duplicate spend/RAVE or introduce signed agreement-bound one-use nonce.
Release agreement has tranche unlocks but no expiry policy; expected behavior must be specified and implemented.
Post-challenge refund to bonded oracle plus separate recipient Accept.
Challenge produces RAVE allocation to reporter and treasury with separate Accepts.
Correctly signed honest statements must not slash.
Bond remains parked through the challenge period.
Only bonded oracle may claim a refund.
